propositions: Bedrock Converse outputConfig (native structured output) is client-side rejected by botocore 1.40.61 with ParamValidationError and requires botocore >= 1.43

The current botocore lock at 1.40.61 is constrained by the extras diamond: [eval] -> inspect-ai -> aioboto3 -> aiobotocore caps boto3 < 1.40.62, conflicting with pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock] requirements
Explicit floor constraints botocore >= 1.43.0 and boto3 >= 1.43.0 must be added to pyproject.toml alongside pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock] dependency
The existing [tool.uv] conflicts block forks eval and bedrock resolution to prevent shared resolution failure, absorbing the eval cap while allowing bedrock extra to use newer botocore
uv lock must succeed with the conflicts block unchanged and dev/bedrock fork must resolve to botocore >= 1.43 while eval fork preserves 1.40.61
